reuse.why: setZero, the N-month averages and the new setLastMonthSpending share getMonthWideCategories and setNMonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own path through getBudgetData with its own hidden and #fixed checks instead of the shared selection.

duplication.why: The template exclusion (goal_def IS NULL) is written in two SQL queries, the hidden rule once in SQL and once in JS, the #fixed check in two places, and the income/tracking guard in four loops.

placement.why: Selection helper, tag predicate and actions all live in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; filtering templates inside the generic getBudgetData query mixes a month-action rule into a data accessor.

scope.why: Besides the four requests, set3MonthAvg is reworked from an inline getCategoryAverage loop to setNMonthAvg and void calls become awaited, changes no step asked for.

maintainability.why: Most actions go through one selection with an explicit includeHiddenCategories option, but the exclusion rules are split between SQL and JS and copyPreviousMonth has to be kept in step by hand with every new rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth uses getBudgetData plus inline hidden/group-hidden and isFixedGroupNote checks instead of getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The month-wide exclusion rules are re-expressed for copyPreviousMonth as a goal_def filter in getBudgetData's SQL plus JS hidden and #fixed checks, mirroring getMonthWideCategories' SQL hiddenFilter and post-filter.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gained includeHiddenCategories with a conditional hiddenFilter SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it via getBudgetData and re-implements the hidden, template and #fixed exclusions.
